lines.line: CLAIM_OK FIX135 co_multiple_conviction_seal-set (repair, grant set 26f8666a03fab4fc) and CLAIM_OK FIX135 ne-setaside-custodial-set (repair, grant set 26f8666a03fab4fc). Both asserted before any family content was read.

The pinned Colorado sources render WITH annotations: pdftoppm 24.02.0 -r 600 -gray -png, no -hide-annotations. Proved on my own tooling before any zero was trusted -- JDF-641 page 5 is 725,313 dark with annotations and 521,645 with them hidden, and inside field 11.1's /Rect the drawing render carries 60,688 against 0 in the control. The difference between the two page totals is 203,668; I carry VF29's correction of my earlier 210,820 rather than re-deriving it.

All 16 written text widgets -- 9 on JDF-641, 7 on JDF-642 -- declared /BS /S /U with a rule-only /AP /N and delivered a closepath-stroked rectangle on all four sides. honorWidgetBorderStyle passed at this family's own call site; the shared default stays false and the other three Colorado forms in DECLARED_UNDERLINE_WIDGETS.json are untouched. All 16 now deliver as a single line, read from the delivered bytes: added dark pixels in the 2 pt bands along the three sides the source does not print fell from 280,002 to 19 canonical and 280,005 to 9 boundary, and all 19 are the descender of the leading 'j' of the e-mail address inside the widget's own rect.

nonWhitespaceGlyphsOutsideMeasuredWriteBoxes was a literal 0 and visualDefects was gated on that literal. Both output-byte glyph readings are now measured from the produced PDF through the shared FIX137 module, an ABSENT reading counts as a defect rather than a zero, and the counter additionally reads what the delivered appearance at each declared-underline widget strokes. That last reading fires 16 times on the pre-repair bytes and 0 times after.

600 dpi, both fixtures, against the annotation-drawing source render. Removed: 0 on every page of both fixtures, and 0 outside every declared write box. Added, canonical: p1 100,576 / p2 0 / p3 0 / p4 0 / p5 12,473 / p6 80,219 / p7 1. Boundary: p1 177,588 / p2 0 / p3 0 / p4 0 / p5 28,035 / p6 152,468 / p7 1. Negative control on pages 2, 3 and 4, which this packet writes nothing on: identical to the pixel in both directions. The single page-7 pixel is the known renderer rounding artefact and was left alone.

Written through generate-product-wiring.mjs --family, which routes through carryForwardGovernance. Digest re-pinned b73f1b3c3121 -> dd8a44b18681; all six governance keys survive; the receipt withdrawn at the earlier repair (48cf9bf5cf44 -> b73f1b3c3121) is preserved verbatim. There was no live receipt to withdraw this time and I authored none. npm run rcap:verify-governance-preservation exits 0, but it reports 279 of 295 records NOT MEASURED because they are not checked out here -- a limit of the sparse worktree, not a pass.

Built with --no-raster as instructed. The 14 committed PNGs depicted the superseded bytes and were removed rather than left to describe a packet that no longer exists; rendered-artifacts.json and independent-visual-review.json now say so in words. rasterState BUILT_RASTER_PENDING. No raster dispatched.

The four pinned Nebraska sources render WITH annotations, proved on this family's OWN source and not only on Colorado's: CC-6-11 page 1 is 1,089,478 dark with annotations and 1,039,749 with them hidden, so 49,729 dark pixels on that page live only inside widget /AP /N streams and this render draws them.

Measured on the COMMITTED, UNMOVED bytes. Canonical added/removed: p1 100,336/22,327; p2 37,717/22,327; p3 0/0; p4 116,109/265,625; p5 62,617/0. Boundary: p1 184,434/22,327; p2 32,665/22,327; p3 0/0; p4 200,209/265,625; p5 151,769/0. Packet page 3, the instruction sheet, is the negative control and is identical to the pixel at 2,528,767. Every figure reproduces VF29. I carry VF29's correction of my earlier page-4 split: the RESET FORM button is 27,805 and the panel 212,327, not 66,690 and 173,442, same sum, same exhaustive close at 265,625.

Read from the committed packets by me: 62 flattened appearance placements per fixture, 787 non-whitespace glyphs canonical and 1,513 boundary, of which 385 are ink the pinned sources themselves ship. 787-385=402 and 1,513-385=1,128, which is VF29's reading exactly; my earlier 218/599 was wrong and I carry the correction. nonWhitespaceGlyphsOutsideMeasuredWriteBoxes is 0 and it is a measurement: all 62 placements sit at a pinned-source widget rect to within 0.01 pt.

Fixed in the builder: sourceIds now assemble CC-6-11, CC-6-11.2, DC-1-15, CC-6-11a, which is the manifest's order 1-4, and the componentDisposition where-strings move with it. The assertion that could not fail was replaced by one that reads the ASSEMBLED DOCUMENT: it loads the saved packet bytes back and recovers each page's source by matching that page's own decompressed content stream. Proved it can fail -- on the old order it throws naming both sequences; on the new order it prints the match on both fixtures.

Both output-byte glyph readings now come from the shared FIX137 module rcap-output-glyph-reading.mjs, per document, against that document's own pinned source. The 16 phantom CC-6-11a selectionControls -- prose fragments harvested off a flat scanned instruction sheet with zero form fields, one of them the corrupted 'bnter the original' -- are dropped at the census rather than described: CC-6-11A now censuses 0 fields and 0 selection controls. Both are opt-ins declared by this family alone on a shared host.

NO NEBRASKA PACKET BYTE MOVED AND THE FAMILY IS STOPPED. The unmodified builder refuses at this base, before any change of mine: '4 disclosed blank(s) carry no plain meaning ... DC-1-15/Text44, Text46, Text1, Text74'. Cause proved both ways: commit e258e47a0 changed the shared rcap-pdf-anchor-capture.mjs so an unmeasurable run's x2 is null, captureWidgetContext coerces that null and discards the printed caption, and DC 1:15's captions are exactly the runs that became unmeasurable. With that ONE file rolled back to e258e47a0^ the unmodified builder reproduces the committed digests dd1cde67 and 07a9b4ab exactly; the file was restored at once. I did not build through it: on the current module 26 of 102 mapped rows lose their printed label and NINE court- and service-owned blanks become participant tasks -- requiredBeforeFiling 21 to 30, with the judge's own signature line printed in the participant's to-do list. That is worse than a wrong page order and the assertion is right to refuse it.

The four siblings do NOT rebuild to their committed digests at this base, before any change of mine: both WV families move both fixtures and then throw 26 blocking findings each, and a rebuild of ANY of the four DELETES the whole governance binding from its product-wiring.json -- including two live RASTER_PASS receipts, runs 33791677725 and 33935771571. Everything was reverted and all four directories are at HEAD. What I could prove and did: I hashed all 52 files in the four directories after a rebuild on the clean builder, reverted, applied my change, rebuilt, and hashed again -- the two lists are identical byte for byte. My first draft of the new assertion DID break both WV families (their manifests name SCA-C906 for three components each); that was a real defect I introduced, found by running it, fixed by collapsing duplicates on both sides, and then additionally put behind a per-family opt-in.

outcome: COLORADO returned COMPLETED with its sixteen boxed writing rules restored to single lines and both glyph readings measured. NEBRASKA returned STOPPED with no byte moved: its builder cannot produce a deliverable packet at this base because a shared-module change of 2026-09-09 destroyed the printed-caption harvest on DC 1:15, and rebuilding through it would hand the participant nine blanks that belong to the court. The three Nebraska repairs are written into the builder, gated per family, and proved to move no sibling byte.
grantsNothing: A repaired packet is review evidence. It authorizes no fulfillment, promotes no route and opens no commercial path.
